description: This file contains helper functions and type definitions for interacting with the Multiverse Explorer API, including fetching graph data, node and path details, and managing bookmarks. It interfaces with Next.js API routes that proxy to an Express backend.

methods.name: fetchMultiverseGraph
methods.description: Fetches a graph of multiverse data based on provided parameters, calling the API route /api/multiverse/graph.

methods.name: fetchMultiverseNodeDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details for a specific node by ID via the API route /api/multiverse/nodes/:id.

methods.name: fetchMultiversePathDetails
methods.description: Retrieves details for a specific path by ID via the API route /api/multiverse/paths/:id.

methods.name: listMultiverseBookmarks
methods.description: Lists bookmarks for a user, optionally filtered by type, limit, and offset.

methods.name: upsertMultiverseBookmark
methods.description: Creates or updates a bookmark for a user.

methods.name: deleteMultiverseBookmark
methods.description: Deletes a specified bookmark for a user.
